customManagers.description: Track LLVM for the 22 LINE. Each line is a separate product with its own lines/<major>/UPSTREAM_VERSION and its own cap, so a line never jumps major: LLVM 23 arrives as a new lines/23/ with its own manager, not by moving this one. depName is per-line (llvm-22) with packageName pointing at the real repo -- one shared depName could not be capped per line.

packageRules.description: The 22 line stays on 22.x. Not an automerge exception -- automerge is the family default (ship-if-green) and still applies; this only stops Renovate from walking the line onto an LLVM major it was never built for.
